text.p: First Southwest Company, announces the
following for the sale of $64,795,000 Texas A & M University System:
Issuer: Board of Regents of The Texas A & M University System
Description: Revenue Financing System Bonds, Series 1997
Selling: June 11, 1997
Time: 1:00 PM CDT
Dated: June 1, 1997 (Interest should be calculated from this new dated
date)
Due: May 15, 1998 to 2017
Closing Date: July 17, 1997
Financial
Advisor: First Southwest Company, Dallas
A $64,795,000 Board of Regents of Texas A & M University System Revenue Financing System Bonds, Series 1997 is scheduled for sale via competitive bid June 11.
The dated date has been changed to June 1, 1997 and interest should be calculated from the new dated date.
The bids will be opened and read at 1:00 PM CDT. Telephone bids will be
accepted between 12:00 PM CDT and 12:50 PM CDT (214) 953-4021. Fax bids
will be accepted between 12:00 PM CDT and 12:50 PM CDT (214) 953-4050.
Bidders must submit signed Official Bid Forms to Mary Williams, First
Southwest Company, 1700 Pacific Avenue, 5th Floor, Dallas, Texas
